subject.title: fix(ollama): resolve web search secret refs

question: Should Ollama web search fail closed when an explicitly configured `models.providers.ollama.apiKey` SecretRef is unavailable, even if ambient `OLLAMA_API_KEY` is set?
rationale: This is a compatibility and credential-routing policy choice: the patch prevents unintended cloud routing, but it intentionally changes fallback behavior for existing mixed configurations.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed resolution
options.body: Treat an explicit unavailable SecretRef as authoritative and land the PR so web search never substitutes an unrelated ambient credential.

options.title: Preserve ambient fallback
options.body: Keep the current fallback semantics for unavailable explicit refs and revise the patch and tests to retain that behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-closed resolution
recommendation.body: Treat an explicit unavailable SecretRef as authoritative and land the PR so web search never substitutes an unrelated ambient credential.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR already requests this owner-level compatibility decision directly in the discussion.
